title: ROAST DUCK WITH ORANGE SAUCE
instructions: --Scrape a tablespoonful each of fat,  bacon, and raw onion and fry them together for five minutes. Add the juice of an orange and a wineglassful of port wine, the drippings from the duck and seasoning of salt and pepper. Keep hot without boiling and serve with roast duck.
